text: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
translation: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

text: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
translation: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture1 that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.

text: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
translation: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

text: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
translation: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

text: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
translation: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kāfūr,1

text: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
translation: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allāh will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

text: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
translation: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.

text: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
translation: And they give food in spite of love for it1 to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,

text: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
translation: [Saying], "We feed you only for the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.

text: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
translation: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."

text: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
translation: So Allāh will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

text: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
translation: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].

text: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
translation: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.

text: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
translation: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.

text: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
translation: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],

text: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
translation: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

text: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
translation: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

text: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
translation: [From] a fountain within it [i.e., Paradise] named Salsabeel.

text: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
translation: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.

text: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
translation: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.

text: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
translation: Upon them [i.e., the inhabitants] will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

text: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
translation: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

text: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
translation: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Qur’ān progressively.

text: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
translation: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].

text: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
translation: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

text: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
translation: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt [i.e., praise] Him a long [part of the] night.

text: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
translation: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them1 a grave Day.

text: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
translation: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

text: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

text: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
translation: And you do not will except that Allāh wills. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

text: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
translation: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
